name: Migration To Aws
description: Plan a migration from Google Cloud Platform (and OpenAI/Gemini AI workloads) to AWS. Analyzes your Infrastructure-as-Code files, app code, and GCP billing data to discover resources, design an AWS architecture, estimate costs, and generate migration artifacts — including AI-provider mapping to Amazon Bedrock. Processing is local; your data stays in your environment.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills**, **6 agents** and **4 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (5): `agent-advisor` (Unified entry point for AI-agent work on AWS: evaluate and pick a runtime, generate a full migration plan…), `gcp-to-aws` (Migrate workloads from Google Cloud Platform to AWS — including AI and agentic workloads regardless of cloud provider), `heroku-to-aws` (Migrate workloads from Heroku to AWS), `llm-to-bedrock` (Use when the user wants to migrate code that calls OpenAI, Gemini/Google AI, or the Anthropic API to…), `tf-best-practices` (Best-practice authoring guidance AND a read-only policy gate for AWS Terraform generated by a migration skill)
- **Agents** (6): `generic-phase-worker-rw` (Generic, phase-AGNOSTIC worker that runs ONE migration phase's work (its fragments + assembler) in an isolated context and…), `llm2bedrock-code-analyzer` (Analyze the local source repo, detect the AI framework and LLM SDK usage, map all call sites, identify…), `llm2bedrock-code-rewriter` (Rewrite LLM SDK calls to Amazon Bedrock on a dedicated git branch, swap dependencies, generate tests, and apply…), `llm2bedrock-log-ingestor` (Parse LLM API logs from the local repo, extract prompt/response pairs, and build a golden dataset (prompts.jsonl) for…), `llm2bedrock-prompt-evaluator` (Run each golden prompt against the target Bedrock model via the pinned uv harness, score with LLM-as-judge, and…), `llm2bedrock-report-generator` (Synthesize all prior phase results into a final Markdown migration report — model mapping, eval scores, code diffs,…)
- **MCP servers** (4): `awsknowledge`, `awspricing`, `temporal-docs`, `aws-pricing-calculator`

Installs with `claude plugin install migration-to-aws@claude-plugins-official` from `awslabs/startups` (`migrate/plugins/migration-to-aws`).
